# Ecclesiastes Chapter 9 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 411r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ECC_009_page_001.jpg

---

**9:4** For whoever [mi asher] is-joined [yechabbar] to all the-living [ha-chayyim] has hope [bitachon]; for a-living [chai] dog [kelev] [is] better [tov] than a-dead [ha-met] lion [ha-aryeh].

**9:7** Go [lekh], eat [ekhol] with-joy [be-simchah] your-bread [lachmekha], and-drink [u-sheteh] with-a-good [tov] heart [lev] your-wine [yeinekha]; for already [kevar] the-God [ha-elohim] has-accepted [ratsah] your-deeds [ma'asekha].

**9:11** Again [shavti] I-saw [ra'oh] under the-sun that the-race [ha-merutsah] [is] not to-the-swift [la-qallim], and-the-battle [ha-milchamah] not to-the-strong [la-gibborim], and-also not to-the-wise [la-chukhamim] bread [lechem], and-also not to-the-understanding [la-nevonim] wealth [osher], and-also not to-the-knowing [la-yod'im] favor [chen]; for time [et] and-chance [vafeqa] happen [yiqreh] to-them-all [et-kullam].

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**v.4 — "a living dog is better than a dead lion":** Dogs were despised in ancient Israel; lions were noble. The reversal makes the point: any life, however lowly, exceeds any death, however glorious.

**v.11 — "time and chance":** *Et vafeqa* — Qohelet's most direct challenge to retribution theology. Success does not reliably follow merit. The race doesn't always go to the swift. The system is not transparent.

*— PNEUMA*
